answer: A sybil attacker creating many identities must pay the bond plus compute for each one, costs that volume linearly and never amortize. Agents must stake a refundable bond and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work whose difficulty is set by the network's current load. Honest peers verify stakes against a shared ledger that acts as a trellis supporting only bonded identities, while a mirror of each agent's work history on a public mesa lets reviewers spot clones instantly. This model fits agent sa0030's threat model.
